try:

# TODO(gtronset): Remove the fallback once beets 2.13 and below are no longer supported.
# https://github.com/gtronset/beets-filetote/issues/402
# beets 2.14 split the item and album commands: `move_items` takes an options
# object, and `modify_items` and `update_items` no longer take `album`.
try:
    from beets.ui.commands.modify import modify_albums
    from beets.ui.commands.move import move_albums
except ImportError:
    BEETS_SPLIT_COMMANDS = False
else:
    BEETS_SPLIT_COMMANDS = True

def _run_cli_move(  # ruff: ignore[too-many-arguments]
        self,
        query: str,
        dest_dir: bytes | None = None,
        album: str | None = None,
        copy: bool = False,
        pretend: bool = False,
        export: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Run the `move` CLI command."""
        if BEETS_SPLIT_COMMANDS:
            opts = SimpleNamespace(
                album=bool(album),
                copy=copy,
                dest=dest_dir,
                export=export,
                pretend=pretend,
                timid=False,
            )
            move = move_albums if album else move_items
            move(self.lib, query, dest_dir, opts)
            return
        move_items(
            self.lib,
            dest_dir,
            query=query,
            copy=copy,
            album=album,
            pretend=pretend,
            confirm=False,
            export=export,
        )

    def _run_cli_modify(  # ruff: ignore[too-many-arguments]
        self,
        query: str,
        mods: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        dels: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        write: bool = True,
        move: bool = True,
        album: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Run the `modify` CLI command."""
        if BEETS_SPLIT_COMMANDS:
            modify = modify_albums if album else modify_items
            modify(
                self.lib,
                query,
                mods={
                    field: ModifyOperation(operator=None, value=val)
                    for field, val in (mods or {}).items()
                },
                dels=list(dels or {}),
                write=write,
                move=move,
                confirm=False,
                inherit=True,
            )
        elif ModifyOperation is not None:
            modify_items(
                lib=self.lib,
                mods={
                    field: ModifyOperation(operator=None, value=val)
                    for field, val in (mods or {}).items()
                },
                dels={
                    field: ModifyOperation(operator=None, value=val)
                    for field, val in (dels or {}).items()
                },
                query=query,
                write=write,
                move=move,
                album=album,
                confirm=False,
                inherit=True,
            )
        else:
            # TODO(gtronset): Remove this once beets 2.12 and below are no longer
            # supported.
            # https://github.com/gtronset/beets-filetote/pull/370
            modify_items(
                lib=self.lib,
                mods=mods or {},
                dels=dels or {},
                query=query,
                write=write,
                move=move,
                album=album,
                confirm=False,
                inherit=True,
            )

    def _run_cli_update(
        self,
        query: str,
        album: str | None = None,
        move: bool = True,
        pretend: bool = False,
        fields: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Run the `update` CLI command."""
        if BEETS_SPLIT_COMMANDS:
            items = (
                [item for found in self.lib.albums(query) for item in found.items()]
                if album
                else list(self.lib.items(query))
            )
            update_items(self.lib, items, move=move, pretend=pretend, fields=fields)
            return
        update_items(
            lib=self.lib,
            query=query,
            album=album,
            move=move,
            pretend=pretend,
            fields=fields,
        )
